title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Closing Terms by Plan
content:
Clause 9 of the Cartwise Shopper Payouts plan terms — how the balance is paid out when a payout account closes, per plan.

9.1 The remaining balance of a closed payout account is paid by the plan's closing disbursement method within the plan's final disbursement period, counted in business days after closure.

9.2 Where the plan's setting in the table below reads "Yes", a payout account whose balance is negative cannot be closed until the balance is recovered.

| Plan | Closing disbursement method | Final disbursement period (business days after closure) | Closure blocked while the balance is negative |
|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | Final ACH deposit to the bank account | 5 | Yes |
| Instant Cashout | Final ACH deposit | 5 | Yes |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | Final card load onto the Everyday Pay Card | 5 | Yes |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | Final card load onto the Everyday Pay Card | 5 | Yes |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | Final card load onto the Everyday Pay Card | 5 | Yes |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | Final card load onto the Everyday Pay Card | 5 | Yes |

9.3 Hypothetical illustration: an Everyday Pay Card Gold account closed on a Monday with no US federal holiday in the following week has its final card load due within 5 business days, that is by the Monday of the following week; an Instant Cashout account closed the same day is paid by final ACH deposit within the same period.
